review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Brewer Sam is on first names with everybody, and he knows how people get on: inviting and visiting, falling out and making up, apologising and forgiving, keeping in touch, and the in-laws.
description.sl: Pivovar Sam je z vsemi na ti in ve, kako se ljudje razumejo: povabila in obiski, sprti in spet pobotani, opravičila in odpuščanje, ohranjanje stikov in tašča s tastom.
description.it: Il birraio Sam dà del tu a tutti e sa come vanno d'accordo le persone: inviti e visite, litigare e fare pace, scusarsi e perdonare, restare in contatto, e i suoceri.
description.de: Brauer Sam ist mit allen per du und weiß, wie die Leute miteinander auskommen: einladen und besuchen, sich zerstreiten und versöhnen, sich entschuldigen und verzeihen, in Kontakt bleiben, und die Schwiegereltern.

words.example_en: Their friendship began at school sixty years ago.
words.example_sl: Njuno prijateljstvo se je začelo v šoli pred šestdesetimi leti.
words.example_it: La loro amicizia è cominciata a scuola sessant'anni fa.
words.example_de: Ihre Freundschaft begann vor sechzig Jahren in der Schule.

words.example_en: Jack gets on well with everyone, even Mr Tyson.
words.example_sl: Jack se dobro razume z vsemi, celo z gospodom Tysonom.
words.example_it: Jack va d'accordo con tutti, perfino con il signor Tyson.
words.example_de: Jack versteht sich mit allen gut, sogar mit Mr Tyson.
words.note: Get on with also means to continue: Get on with your work!
words.note_sl: Get on with pomeni tudi nadaljevati: Get on with your work!
words.note_it: Get on with vuol dire anche continuare: Get on with your work!
words.note_de: Get on with heißt auch weitermachen: Get on with your work!

words.example_en: The two farmers fell out over a wall and didn't speak for years.
words.example_sl: Kmeta sta se sprla zaradi zidu in leta nista govorila.
words.example_it: I due contadini hanno rotto i rapporti per un muro e non si sono parlati per anni.
words.example_de: Die zwei Bauern haben sich wegen einer Mauer zerstritten und jahrelang nicht geredet.

words.example_en: Harry and Poppy argue every morning and make up every afternoon.
words.example_sl: Harry in Poppy se zjutraj prepirata, popoldne pa se pobotata.
words.example_it: Harry e Poppy litigano ogni mattina e fanno pace ogni pomeriggio.
words.example_de: Harry und Poppy streiten jeden Morgen und versöhnen sich jeden Nachmittag.
words.note: Make up also means to invent: He made up the whole story.
words.note_sl: Make up pomeni tudi izmisliti si: He made up the whole story.
words.note_it: Make up vuol dire anche inventare: He made up the whole story.
words.note_de: Make up heißt auch erfinden: He made up the whole story.

words.example_en: Maggie invited the whole street to her eightieth birthday.
words.example_sl: Maggie je na osemdeseti rojstni dan povabila vso ulico.
words.example_it: Maggie ha invitato tutta la via al suo ottantesimo compleanno.
words.example_de: Maggie hat die ganze Straße zu ihrem achtzigsten Geburtstag eingeladen.

words.example_en: Thank you for the invitation, we'd love to come.
words.example_sl: Hvala za povabilo, z veseljem pridemo.
words.example_it: Grazie per l'invito, veniamo volentieri.
words.example_de: Danke für die Einladung, wir kommen sehr gern.

words.example_en: We visit Edna every Sunday after church.
words.example_sl: Edno obiščemo vsako nedeljo po maši.
words.example_it: Andiamo a trovare Edna ogni domenica dopo la messa.
words.example_de: Wir besuchen Edna jeden Sonntag nach der Kirche.

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett is the perfect host: nobody's glass is ever empty.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett je popolna gostiteljica: nikomur kozarec ni nikoli prazen.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett sa ospitare alla perfezione: nessuno ha mai il bicchiere vuoto.
words.example_de: Mrs Birkett ist die perfekte Gastgeberin: Niemandes Glas ist je leer.

words.example_en: In a small village, a stranger is noticed at once.
words.example_sl: V majhni vasi neznanca takoj opazijo.
words.example_it: In un paese piccolo uno sconosciuto si nota subito.
words.example_de: In einem kleinen Dorf fällt ein Fremder sofort auf.
words.note: A false friend: a stranger is someone you don't know, not a foreigner.
words.note_sl: Lažni prijatelj: stranger je neznanec, ne tujec iz druge države (foreigner).
words.note_it: Falso amico: stranger è uno sconosciuto, non uno straniero (foreigner).
words.note_de: Falscher Freund: stranger ist ein Unbekannter, nicht unbedingt ein Ausländer (foreigner).

words.example_en: He's not really a friend, just an acquaintance from the pub.
words.example_sl: Ni ravno prijatelj, samo znanec iz gostilne.
words.example_it: Non è proprio un amico, solo un conoscente del pub.
words.example_de: Er ist nicht wirklich ein Freund, nur ein Bekannter aus dem Pub.

words.example_en: Jack and Lucy got engaged at the top of Helvellyn.
words.example_sl: Jack in Lucy sta se zaročila na vrhu Helvellyna.
words.example_it: Jack e Lucy si sono fidanzati in cima all'Helvellyn.
words.example_de: Jack und Lucy haben sich auf dem Gipfel des Helvellyn verlobt.

words.example_en: Maggie and her husband were married for fifty years.
words.example_sl: Maggie in mož sta bila poročena petdeset let.
words.example_it: Maggie e suo marito sono stati sposati per cinquant'anni.
words.example_de: Maggie und ihr Mann waren fünfzig Jahre verheiratet.
words.note: Married to someone, never with: She's married to a farmer.
words.note_sl: Married to someone: s predlogom to.
words.note_it: Married to someone, mai with: She's married to a farmer.
words.note_de: Married to someone, nie with: She's married to a farmer.

words.example_en: Her parents are divorced, but they still sit together at the show.
words.example_sl: Njena starša sta ločena, a na razstavi še vedno sedita skupaj.
words.example_it: I suoi genitori sono divorziati, ma alla fiera siedono ancora insieme.
words.example_de: Ihre Eltern sind geschieden, aber auf der Schau sitzen sie noch zusammen.

words.example_en: At Christmas all our relatives come from Carlisle.
words.example_sl: Za božič pridejo vsi naši sorodniki iz Carlisla.
words.example_it: A Natale vengono tutti i nostri parenti da Carlisle.
words.example_de: An Weihnachten kommen alle unsere Verwandten aus Carlisle.
words.note: A false friend: relatives are your family; parents are only your mother and father.
words.note_sl: Relatives so sorodniki; parents sta samo starša.
words.note_it: Falso amico: i parenti sono relatives; parents sono solo i genitori.
words.note_de: Relatives sind Verwandte; parents sind nur die Eltern.

words.example_en: We're spending the weekend with my in-laws in Kendal.
words.example_sl: Konec tedna bomo pri tastu in tašči v Kendalu.
words.example_it: Passiamo il fine settimana dai miei suoceri a Kendal.
words.example_de: Wir verbringen das Wochenende bei meinen Schwiegereltern in Kendal.

words.example_en: Happy birthday, Wilf! How old are you today?
words.example_sl: Vse najboljše za rojstni dan, Wilf! Koliko si star danes?
words.example_it: Buon compleanno, Wilf! Quanti anni compi oggi?
words.example_de: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag, Wilf! Wie alt bist du heute?

words.example_en: They celebrated the end of the harvest with a barn dance.
words.example_sl: Konec žetve so praznovali s plesom na skednju.
words.example_it: Hanno festeggiato la fine del raccolto con un ballo nel fienile.
words.example_de: Sie haben das Ende der Ernte mit einem Scheunentanz gefeiert.

words.example_en: He apologised for being late and bought everyone a drink.
words.example_sl: Opravičil se je za zamudo in vsem plačal pijačo.
words.example_it: Si è scusato per il ritardo e ha offerto da bere a tutti.
words.example_de: Er hat sich für die Verspätung entschuldigt und allen etwas ausgegeben.
words.note: British apologise, American apologize. Apologise for something, to someone.
words.note_sl: Britansko apologise, ameriško apologize. Apologise for (za), to (komu).
words.note_it: Britannico apologise, americano apologize. Apologise for (per), to (a qualcuno).
words.note_de: Britisch apologise, amerikanisch apologize. Apologise for (für), to (bei jemandem).

words.example_en: It took her a long time to forgive him.
words.example_sl: Dolgo je trajalo, preden mu je odpustila.
words.example_it: Le ci è voluto molto tempo per perdonarlo.
words.example_de: Sie brauchte lange, um ihm zu verzeihen.

words.example_en: You can trust Mr Dixon: he always does what he says.
words.example_sl: Gospodu Dixonu lahko zaupaš: vedno naredi, kar reče.
words.example_it: Puoi fidarti del signor Dixon: fa sempre quello che dice.
words.example_de: Du kannst Mr Dixon vertrauen: Er tut immer, was er sagt.

words.example_en: Let's keep in touch when you move to London.
words.example_sl: Ostaniva v stiku, ko se preseliš v London.
words.example_it: Restiamo in contatto quando ti trasferisci a Londra.
words.example_de: Lass uns in Kontakt bleiben, wenn du nach London ziehst.

words.example_en: Shall we meet up for a coffee in Keswick on Saturday?
words.example_sl: Se dobiva na kavi v Keswicku v soboto?
words.example_it: Ci vediamo per un caffè a Keswick sabato?
words.example_de: Wollen wir uns am Samstag in Keswick auf einen Kaffee treffen?

words.example_en: Poppy's best friend lives on the farm across the beck.
words.example_sl: Poppyjina najboljša prijateljica živi na kmetiji onstran potoka.
words.example_it: La migliore amica di Poppy vive nella fattoria oltre il ruscello.
words.example_de: Poppys beste Freundin wohnt auf dem Hof auf der anderen Seite des Bachs.

words.example_en: Let me introduce you to my neighbour, Mr Dixon.
words.example_sl: Naj te predstavim sosedu, gospodu Dixonu.
words.example_it: Lascia che ti presenti il mio vicino, il signor Dixon.
words.example_de: Darf ich dir meinen Nachbarn vorstellen, Mr Dixon?
